description: This source file defines an API endpoint for authenticating users in the eShopOnWeb application. It handles login requests by verifying credentials and generating authentication tokens.

classes.name: AuthenticateEndpoint
classes.description: An API endpoint class that handles user authentication requests, validates credentials, and issues JWT tokens.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Processes the authentication request, performs sign-in, evaluates result, and returns an authentication response containing token and status information.
